tracking: lane E30 incident console (decision in PR #925): the brief is API-only (lane rule 3); the incident console screen is for the design builder on #453

gaps.GET /v1/workflows/incidents: lists stuck or failed workflow instances (failed stage, failed check, deploy handoff, lapsed claim) with what each waits on and which actions are allowed and why not
gaps.POST /v1/workflows/instances/:instanceId: re-runs the stuck or failed stage of a workflow instance (the executor, or a recheck of a failed check), with a note, audited
skips a stuck check stage the template marks skippable (never a review or approval), with a note, step-up and audit
cancels (aborts) a stuck or failed workflow instance, with a note, audited
